title: Community
postGoneBody: It was deleted, or you can no longer see it.

feed.label: Feed
feed.emptyBody: Follow people or join a group and their posts show up here. Yours too.
feed.discoverEmptyBody: Public posts from public accounts appear here.

search.people: Search people by name or username

follow.unfollowPrivate: This account is private: you will need to request again to see their posts.

profile.noPostsSelf: You have not shared anything yet
profile.privateBody: Follow it and once your request is accepted you will see the posts.
profile.unavailableBody: This person is not in Community, or the profile is hidden from you.
profile.joinToSeeBody: Join Community to see profiles, posts and followers.
profile.removeFollowerBody: They stop seeing your followers-only posts. They are not told, and they can request again.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.body: You stop following each other and neither of you sees the other's profile, posts or group membership. Their likes on your posts are removed. You can unblock in Community settings.

report.intro: Reports go to the app's admins only. The person is not told who reported.
report.sentBody: An admin will review it. You can also block the account so you no longer see each other.

intro.title: Train with people you choose
intro.lead: Share workouts, meals and programs, follow friends and join groups. Community is optional; the rest of {{app}} works without it.

facts.privateHint: Only followers you accept see your posts. You can go public later.
facts.visible: Others see only what you post
facts.visibleHint: Name, username, photo, level, badges and bio. Never weight, sleep or meals unless you share them.
facts.photosHint: A downscaled copy visible to the audience you pick; your private album stays encrypted.
facts.blockHint: Blocked people cannot see you. Reports go to the admins.
facts.leaveHint: Posts, likes, follows, groups and notifications. You can also just pause.

intro.underageBody: You need to be 18 or older to use Community. Workouts, tracking and the ranking keep working as usual.
intro.birthYearBody: Community is 18+, so we need your birth year to check it. It stays private.
intro.rankingStill: The Ranking tab works without joining.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyBody: Follows, likes and group news show up here.

kinds.group_accepted: You are now a member of {{group}}

groups.title: Group
groups.emptyBody: Start one for your gym crew or search for an open group.

form.name: Name
form.openHint: Anyone in Community can join and see posts.
form.closedHint: Only the name shows up in search. People join with the invite link or after you approve them.

groups.goneBody: It was deleted or is hidden from you.
groups.pendingNote: An admin will review your request.
groups.noPosts: No posts in this group yet
groups.closedBody: Posts and members are visible to members only. Join with an invite link or send a request.
groups.leaveBody: Your posts in this group are no longer visible to its members.
groups.leaveOwnerBody: Ownership passes to the oldest admin or member; an empty group is deleted.
groups.joinBody: You were invited with this code. Join to see the group's posts and members.
groups.joinNeedsSocial: Join Community first, then open the invite link again.
groups.rotateHint: The old link and code stop working.
groups.deleteBody: The group, its members and all its posts are deleted. This cannot be undone.
groups.membersOnly_one: {{count}} member · Only group members can see the member list.
groups.membersOnly_other: {{count}} members · Only group members can see the member list.
groups.bansHint: Removed people cannot rejoin with the invite code or a request until you lift the ban.

settings.title: Community
settings.rowHint: Private account, followers, blocked people, leaving
settings.offHint: You are not in Community. Joining needs your consent and is 18+.
settings.privateOnHint: Only followers you accept see your posts. New followers need your approval.
settings.privateOffHint: Anyone in Community can follow you and see your public posts. Going public accepts all pending requests.
settings.discoverableHint: Off: you are not in search or Discover; people find you only through a link or a group.
settings.bioPlaceholder: A line about you and your training
settings.pushHint: Follows, likes and group news; at most one push every 10 minutes.
settings.blockedHint: Blocked people cannot see your profile, posts or groups, and you cannot see theirs.
settings.leaveHint: The rest of the app keeps working either way.
settings.pauseHint: You disappear for everyone; your data is kept until you come back.
settings.pauseBody: Your profile, posts and groups are hidden from everyone until you join again.
settings.leaveConfirmBody: Your posts and their photos, likes, follows in both directions, group memberships (owned groups pass to another member) and notifications are deleted.

admin.title: Reports
admin.targetGone: The reported content no longer exists.
admin.removeBody: The post and its photos are deleted for everyone and every open report on it is resolved.
